sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-GGUF is a quantized version of Meta's Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct model, optimized for efficient local inference using the llama.cpp runtime. Created by bartowski, this model uses imatrix-calibrated quantizations built with llama.cpp release b3821, enabling the 3-billion-parameter instruction-tuned Llama model to run on consumer hardware with minimal performance ...

sources.snippet: For fine-tuning with Unsloth's optimization, a single Tesla T4 GPU suffices for full training of the 3B model. Q: How does this quantized GGUF version compare to the full-precision Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct? A: The GGUF version trades output quality for dramatic reductions in memory footprint and inference latency.
